note: Set A binds values more faithfully overall: its member profiles, plate sizes, scales and revision rows match the page, and it avoids inventing conditions. Set B captures a few good facts A misses (the 1/4" weld size, 1/4" stiff plates, T.O. STEEL 11'-4", the bent plate and PL dimensions), but it introduces several unsupported claims (slope/gap 1/4" at "upper" and "lower" edge, "cutting plane E", an unspecified 1 1/2" "offset distance", and 1'-0" "spacing" read from the scale line) and repeats the same facts two or three times. A's main errors are the 11"X3/8" support plate mislabeled as "reinforcement", the scale 1 1/2" = 1'-0" misread as reinforcement spacing, and a 1/4" weld symbol read as a slope. On balance A is the cleaner, more correct set despite omitting some valid details.
remarks: Both sets read the 1 1/2" = 1'-0" scale line as an engineering dimension (A: reinforcement spacing; B: component spacing) — a recurring pattern worth flagging. A also calls the 1/4"▽ weld symbol a slope, while B correctly reads it as a weld size. Facts both sets leave out or only partly capture: W8X10 members, the 5"X3/8" continuous support plates, the 2'-9 1/16" and 3'-0" dimensions, and the 11"X3/8" support plate width is never stated as a plate size in B. Detail-to-member bindings (e.g. whether L4X4X5/16 belongs to the West or East roof cantilever) could not be verified with certainty at this image resolution.
